passage: Raising corporate tax rates can be a viable policy tool to address income inequality and generate revenue for public goods. Large corporations have seen their profits soar in recent years, while many workers have struggled to make ends meet. By increasing corporate tax rates, the government can help redistribute some of this wealth and invest in essential public services like education, healthcare, and infrastructure. This can also help to reduce the burden on individual taxpayers and create a more progressive tax system. Furthermore, many countries with higher corporate tax rates have still managed to attract businesses and drive economic growth, suggesting that the negative impact on investment and job creation may be overstated. Additionally, closing tax loopholes and eliminating deductions can help ensure that corporations pay their fair share, rather than exploiting loopholes to avoid taxes. Overall, significantly raising corporate tax rates can be a crucial step towards creating a more equitable and sustainable economy.
